description:
Minimal, Docker-free Quarkus app that adds a quarkus-micrometer registry on top of the
        bootui-quarkus extension and proves the Metrics panel light-up: meters registered on the live composite
        MeterRegistry are read in process by the shared engine MetricsReportProvider, grouped and mapped onto
        the neutral MetricsReport, and surfaced on GET /bootui/api/metrics — while meters describing BootUI's
        own /bootui/** traffic are hidden by the shared engine MeterSelfFilter. Kept separate from
        bootui-quarkus-integration-tests (which deliberately has NO Micrometer registry) so the registry-absent
        unavailable path and the registry-present capture path are each proven in isolation — the same split
        used for the SmallRye-Health-present/absent and OpenTelemetry-present/absent coverage.
